grammar_tips.title: Using 'a' and 'an' with objects
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'a' before words starting with a consonant sound. Example: a pen, a book.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'a' का प्रयोग व्यंजन ध्वनि से शुरू होने वाले शब्दों के लिए करें। उदाहरण: a pen, a book.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 子音で始まる単語には「a」を使います。例：a pen, a book.

grammar_tips.title: This is/These are
grammar_tips.explanation: Use 'This is' for one object and 'These are' for many. Example: This is a chair. These are books.

explanation_translation.Hindi: 'This is' एक वस्तु के लिए, 'These are' एक से अधिक के लिए। उदाहरण: This is a chair. These are books.
explanation_translation.Japanese: 1つの物は「This is」、複数は「These are」を使います。例：This is a chair. These are books.
